purpose: Preserve old Text7 carrier and parser sketches, historical speed benchmark and contextual binder tests as complete source artifacts in main. Never replay old runtime changes into current main.

files.content:
name: Text7 packed codec benchmark

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "crates/sens/src/packed_bits.rs"
      - "crates/sens/examples/text7_pack_bench.rs"
      - "docs/research/data/1700-uk-literals-vs-upc7.tsv"
      - ".github/workflows/text7-pack-bench.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Build benchmark
        run: cargo build --release -p sens --example text7_pack_bench
      - name: Run Text7 speed benchmark
        run: target/release/examples/text7_pack_bench | tee /tmp/text7-pack-bench.txt
      - name: Publish result
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## Text7 packed codec benchmark" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          cat /tmp/text7-pack-bench.txt >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: text7-pack-bench
          path: /tmp/text7-pack-bench.txt
          retention-days: 14
